verses.text: <pb/><t>Ku kasa kunne! Hikima tana kira.</t> <t>Tana so a ji ta.</t>
<t>Tana tsaye bisa kan tuddai a bakin hanya</t> <t>Da a mararraban hanyoyi.</t>
<t>A ƙofofin shiga birni, tana kira,</t>
<t>“Ina roƙonku, ya ku, 'yan adam,</t> <t>Ina kiran kowane mutum da yake a duniya.</t>
<t>Ba ku balaga ba? To, ku balaga.</t> <t>Ku wawaye ne? Ku koyi hankali.</t>
<t>Ku kasa kunne ga jawabina mafi kyau,</t> <t>Dukan abin da na faɗa muku daidai ne.</t>
<t>Abin da na faɗa gaskiya ne,</t> <t>Ƙarairayi abin ƙi ne a gare ni.</t>
<t>Kowane abu da na faɗa gaskiya ne,</t> <t>Ba wani abu da yake na laifi ko na ruɗawa.</t>
<t>Ga mutum mai basira, dukan abu ne a sarari,</t> <t>Ga wanda aka sanar da shi sosai, abu ne a sawwaƙe.</t>
<t>Ka zaɓi koyarwata fiye da azurfa,</t> <t>Ka zaɓi ilimi fiye da zinariya tsantsa. <pb/></t>
<t>“Ni ce hikima, na fi lu'ulu'ai,</t> <t>Cikin dukan abin da kake so, ba kamata.</t>
<t>Ni ce hikima, ina da basira,</t> <t>Ina da ilimi da faɗar daidai.</t>
<t>Ƙin mugunta shi ne tsoron Ubangiji,</t> <t>Na ƙi girmankai, da fāriya, da mugayen hanyoyi,</t> <t>Da maganganu na ƙarya.</t>
<t>Nakan shirya abin da zan yi, in kuwa yi shi.</t> <t>Ina da fahimi, ina da ƙarfi.</t>
<t>Nakan taimaki sarakuna su yi mulki,</t> <t>Mahukunta kuma su tsara dokoki masu kyau.</t>
<t>Kowane mai mulki a duniya, da taimakona yake mulki,</t> <t>Ƙusoshin hukumomi da dattawan gari duka ɗaya.</t>
<t>Ina ƙaunar waɗanda suke ƙaunata,</t> <t>Dukan wanda yake nemana kuma zai same ni.</t>
<t>Ina da dukiya da daraja da zan bayar,</t> <t>Da wadata da nasara kuma.</t>
<t>Abin da za ka samu daga gare ni</t> <t>Ya fi zinariya kyau, da azurfa tsantsa.</t>
<t>A kan hanyar adalci nake tafiya,</t> <t>Rankai a kan hanyoyin gaskiya.</t>
<t>Ina ba da dukiya ga waɗanda suke ƙaunata,</t> <t>Ina kuma cika gidajensu da wadata. <pb/></t>
<t>“Ni ce halittar farko da Ubangiji</t> <t>Ya fara halittawa daga cikin ayyukansa tuntuni.</t>
<t>Da farkon farawa ni aka fara halittawa</t> <t>Kafin a yi duniya.</t>
<t>Ni aka fara yi kafin tekuna,</t> <t>A sa'ad da ba maɓuɓɓugan ruwa.</t>
<t>Ni aka fara yi kafin a yi duwatsu,</t> <t>Kafin a kafa tuddai a wurarensu,</t>
<t>Kafin Allah ya halicci duniya da filayenta,</t> <t>Ko ɗan ɓarɓashin ƙasa.</t>
<t>A can nake sa'ad da ya shata sararin sama,</t> <t>Da sa'ad da ya shimfiɗa al'arshi a hayin tekuna,</t>
<t>Da sa'ad da ya sa gizagizai a sararin sama,</t> <t>Ya buɗe maɓuɓɓugan teku,</t>
<t>Ya kuma umarci ruwan teku, kada ya zarce wurin da ya sa.</t> <t>Ina can sa'ad da ya kafa harsashin ginin duniya.</t>
<t>Ina kusa da shi kamar mai tsara fasalin gini,</t> <t>Ni ce abar murnarsa kowace rana,</t> <t>A ko yaushe ina farin ciki a gabansa.</t>
<t>Ina farin ciki da duniya,</t> <t>Ina murna da 'yan adam. <pb/></t>
<t>“Yanzu ku matasa, ku kasa kunne gare ni,</t> <t>Ku yi abin da na ce, za ku yi farin ciki.</t>
<t>Ku saurari abin da aka koya muku,</t> <t>Ku zama masu hikima, kada ku yi sakaci da ita.</t>
<t>Mutumin da ya kasa kunne gare ni, zai yi farin ciki haka nan,</t> <t>Wato yakan tsaya a ƙofata ko yaushe,</t> <t>Yana kuma jira a ƙofar shiga gidana.</t>
<t>Mutumin da ya same ni ya sami rai,</t> <t>Ubangiji zai ji daɗinsa.</t>
<t>Mutumin da bai same ni ba ya cuci kansa,</t> <t>Duk wanda yake ƙina mutuwa yake ƙauna.”</t>
